name: Montana
headline_status: Recreational and medical cannabis are legal for adults 21+.
summary: Montana voters approved medical cannabis in 2004 and adult-use legalization (I-190) in 2020, and licensed adult-use businesses opened in January 2022. Adults can carry 1 ounce and grow a small number of plants at home. Adult-use purchases carry a 20% state tax and medical purchases 4%. In 2025 lawmakers banned synthetic THC products such as delta-8 and rejected proposals for a THC potency cap and a consumer registry.

adult_use_since.value: Legalized by Initiative 190, approved by 57% of voters in November 2020.

possession_limit.value: Up to 1 ounce, of which no more than 8 grams may be concentrate; edibles capped at 800 mg THC.

home_grow.value: Up to 2 mature plants and 2 seedlings per adult (4 and 4 for registered patients), with no more than double that per residence; plants must be locked and out of public view.

public_use.value: Smoking in public outside a licensed area is a civil infraction with a fine of up to $50.

retail_sales.value: Adult-use businesses first opened in January 2022.

taxes.value: 20% state tax on adult-use sales and 4% on medical sales, collected at retail; counties may add up to 3%.

regulator.value: Cannabis and Alcohol Regulation Division of the Montana Department of Revenue.

hemp_thc.value: Synthetic THC products such as delta-8 were banned by the 2025 Legislature.

timeline.event: HB 49, a synthetic cannabinoid regulation bill, is signed.

faq.a: Yes. Adults 21 and older can buy and possess cannabis, and medical cannabis has been legal since 2004.

faq.q: How much weed can you carry in Montana?
faq.a: Up to 1 ounce, including no more than 8 grams of concentrate.

faq.q: Can you grow weed in Montana?
faq.a: Yes. Adults may grow 2 mature plants and 2 seedlings, locked and out of public view; registered patients may grow more.

faq.q: What is the marijuana tax in Montana?
faq.a: 20% on adult-use purchases and 4% on medical purchases, plus up to 3% in counties that adopt a local tax.
